basic_details.job_title: SCPWD Kerala Clerk Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The State Commissionerate for Persons with Disabilities (ഭിന്നശേഷിക്കാർക്കായുള്ള സംസ്ഥാന കമ്മീഷണറേറ്റ്), Government of Kerala, is filling 1 Clerk post on a contract basis, temporarily. The application, with copies of certificates proving qualification and age, must reach the Administrative Officer at the Commissionerate's office in Sasthamangalam, Thiruvananthapuram, by post or directly, before 5 PM on 16 November 2026. Applications received after that time will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: About SCPWD Kerala
content_sections.text: The State Commissionerate for Persons with Disabilities is an office of the Government of Kerala, located at Anjaneya, T.C 9/1023 (1), Ground Floor, Sasthamangalam, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 010. The notice is signed by Prof. (Dr.) P.T. Babu Raj, State Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities. The Clerk post is in the Commissionerate itself.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by post, or hand it in directly, to this address: Administrative Officer, State Commissionerate for Persons with Disabilities, Anjaneya, T.C 9/1023 (1), Ground Floor, Sasthamangalam, Thiruvananthapuram. The letterhead of the notice gives the office's PIN code as 695 010. The application must reach the office before 5 PM on 16 November 2026. Applications received after 5 PM on 16 November 2026 will not be accepted, so the date counts for receipt, not for dispatch. The notice does not prescribe an application form or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Clerk (1 vacancy), at a monthly pay of Rs. 23,360/-. The details printed for the post are: Educational qualification: SSLC. Other requirement: Computer knowledge. Desirable: Work experience in a similar field in Government, Semi-Government or private institutions. Monthly pay: Rs. 23,360/-. Nature of appointment: Contract basis, on a temporary arrangement. Age: The notice asks for copies of certificates proving age, but the age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates can refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copies of certificates proving educational qualification. Copies of certificates proving age.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SCPWD Kerala Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Clerk vacancy at the State Commissionerate for Persons with Disabilities, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SCPWD Kerala Clerk post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office before 5 PM on 16 November 2026. Applications received after that time will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the SCPWD Kerala Clerk post?
faq.answer: Candidates need SSLC and computer knowledge. Work experience in a similar field in Government, Semi-Government or private institutions is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the SCPWD Kerala Clerk post?
Q5. How do I apply for the SCPWD Kerala Clerk post?
faq.answer: Send the application with copies of certificates proving qualification and age by post, or submit it directly, to the Administrative Officer, State Commissionerate for Persons with Disabilities, Anjaneya, T.C 9/1023 (1), Ground Floor, Sasthamangalam, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q6. Is the SCPWD Kerala Clerk job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice states the appointment is on a contract basis and temporary.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must be attached to the application?
faq.answer: Copies of certificates proving qualification and copies of certificates proving age must be attached.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply by email for the SCPWD Kerala Clerk post?
faq.answer: The notice allows the application only by post or by submitting it directly at the office; the email address on the letterhead is not given as a way to apply.
